Ensinar adultos: os 5 princípios que faz: Teaching adults: the 5 principles that make the class use it on Monday
Adulto não aprende IA assistindo palestr: Adults don't learn AI by sitting through a lecture. They learn when they see the why, work on a problem of their own, practice with feedback, try to remember without looking, and use it again the following week. This lesson turns that into 5 principles and a lesson plan you can reuse in every workshop.

Adulto pergunta \"para que serve isso no: Adults ask "what is this for in my work?" before they pay attention. Open with the problem the class already feels (a queue of messages, a report that eats the afternoon) and only then show the tool. It comes from Malcolm Knowles' theory of adult learning: the need to know.
O exercício usa a tarefa que a pessoa fa: The exercise uses the task the person does every week, not a textbook example. Juliana, in customer service, practices with a customer complaint; Patrícia, in sales, with a proposal. The learner's experience is the material of the lesson.
Prática deliberada: uma tarefa um pouco: Deliberate practice: a task a little above what the person already does, with immediate feedback and a second attempt. Showing 10 features is worth less than doing 1 task twice, with the second better than the first.
Pergunte antes de reexplicar. Tentar lem: Ask before you re-explain. Trying to remember (even getting it wrong) fixes more than rereading: it's the testing effect, measured in labs and in classrooms. A 3-question quiz at the end is worth more than a summary read aloud.

Porquê e problema real prendem a atenção: Why and real problem hold attention; practice, retrieval, and next week make the habit stick.
Se só der tempo para um princípio, fique: If you only have time for one principle, keep the real problem: it's what changes the outcome of an AI workshop the most.

Reply the AI prepared for the customer (code C-1182):
